profile.name: Enterprise Complete Clean Code, Security & Performance Profile

sonarjs/no-all-duplicated-branches.description: Conditional operations must not return or execute identical logic across all branches (S1871, S3923).

sonarjs/no-identical-expressions.description: Identical expressions on both sides of a binary operator (e.g. `a === a`, `x && x`) must be eliminated (S1764).

sonarjs/no-identical-conditions.description: Identical conditions in if/else-if chains or switch cases must be eliminated (S1862).

sonarjs/no-unthrown-error.description: Error or Exception instances created must be thrown or returned, not left floating (S3984).

sonarjs/no-dead-store.description: Unused assignments and dead store variables must be removed (S1854).

sonarjs/no-unused-vars.description: Variables, parameters, or imports declared but never used must be removed (S1481).

sonarjs/no-ignored-return.description: Return values of pure, immutable, or state-returning methods must not be ignored (S2201).

sonarjs/cognitive-complexity.description: Function cognitive complexity must remain <= 15. Break complex methods into modular units (S3776).

sonarjs/no-redundant-jump.description: Redundant return, continue, break, or jump statements must be eliminated (S3626).

sonarjs/no-nested-conditional.description: Nested ternary operators are prohibited. Refactor into explicit if-else or early returns (S3358).

sonarjs/no-duplicate-string.description: Strings duplicated 3+ times must be extracted into dedicated constants (S1192).

sonarjs/no-useless-catch.description: Catch blocks that only rethrow the caught exception without handling or logging must be removed (S2737).

sonarjs/no-gratuitous-expressions.description: Boolean expressions that evaluate to constant true or false must be cleaned up (S2589).

sonarjs/no-commented-code.description: Commented-out code blocks must be removed to preserve clean codebases (S125).

sonarjs/no-redundant-boolean.description: Redundant boolean literals in expressions (e.g. `if (x === true)` or `return x ? true : false`) must be simplified (S1125).

sonarjs/no-collapsible-if.description: Nested `if` statements without else branches should be merged into a single conditional (S1066).

sonarjs/no-inverted-boolean-check.description: Inverted boolean conditions (e.g. `!(a === b)`) should be written in natural form (`a !== b`) (S1940).

sonarjs/prefer-immediate-return.description: Intermediate local variables declared solely to be returned on the next line should be returned immediately (S1488).

sonarjs/non-existent-operator.description: Typos in assignment operators like `=-` or `=+` instead of `-=` or `+=` must be fixed (S2757).

sonarjs/no-useless-increment.description: Post-increment/decrement operators used in return statements (e.g. `return count++;`) that have no effect must be fixed (S2123).

sonarjs/no-hardcoded-credentials.description: Hardcoded passwords, API keys, private tokens, DB connection strings, and secrets are strictly forbidden (S2068 / OWASP A07).

sonarjs/sql-injection-risk.description: Raw SQL string concatenation or unparameterized queries are strictly prohibited (S2077, S3649 / OWASP A03).

sonarjs/no-insecure-randomness.description: Pseudorandom number generators (e.g. `Math.random()`, `Random()`) must not be used for security-sensitive tokens, passwords, cryptography, or session identifiers. Use cryptographically secure alternatives (`crypto.getRandomValues()`, `Random.secure()`, `RandomNumberGenerator`) (S2245 / OWASP A02).

sonarjs/no-eval-or-unsafe-code-execution.description: Execution of dynamic code using `eval()`, `new Function()`, or dynamic string timers is strictly prohibited (S1523 / OWASP A03).

sonarjs/no-unsafe-regex.description: Regular expressions vulnerable to polynomial or exponential backtracking (ReDoS) must be refactored (S5852 / CWE-1333).

sonarjs/path-traversal-prevention.description: Unsanitized user inputs used directly in filesystem path construction (`path.join()`, `File()`) without canonicalization or bounds checking must be blocked (CWE-22 / OWASP A01).

sonarjs/secure-ssrf-prevention.description: Outbound HTTP requests constructed with unvalidated user-supplied URLs must validate against an allowed domain whitelist to prevent Server-Side Request Forgery (CWE-918 / OWASP A10).

sonarjs/secure-cors-policy.description: Wildcard CORS headers (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`) must never be paired with credential sharing (`AllowCredentials: true`) (S5122).

sonarjs/secure-cookie-config.description: Sensitive session cookies must have `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, and appropriate `SameSite` flags enabled (S3330, S2092).

customRules.name: No BuildContext Across Async Gaps Without Mounted Guard
customRules.description: In Flutter/Dart, using `BuildContext` across asynchronous gaps (after `await`) without verifying `if (!context.mounted) return;` or `if (!mounted) return;` is prohibited. Unmounted context access causes runtime crashes when the user navigates away before async completion.

customRules.name: No Blocking Main Thread / Startup Lifecycle Over-Initialization
customRules.description: Prohibit heavy, sequential, or blocking synchronous/asynchronous initializations in app entry points (`main.dart` in Flutter, `Program.cs` in .NET, `index.ts`/`App.tsx` in React/Next.js) before the initial UI frame renders (`runApp()` or initial paint). Non-essential SDKs (Analytics, Ads, Sentry, Crashlytics), heavy file I/O, and blocking network calls MUST be deferred after the first frame (`addPostFrameCallback`) or offloaded to background tasks.

customRules.name: Offload Heavy Computations from Flutter Main Isolate
customRules.description: In Flutter/Dart, CPU-intensive data parsing, large JSON decodes, image processing, or cryptography must NOT run directly on the main UI isolate. Must use `compute()` or `Isolate.run()` to prevent UI jank, frame drops, and thread starvation.

customRules.name: Prefer Const Constructors on Immutable Widgets
customRules.description: In Flutter, static/immutable widget subtrees and leaf widgets must use `const` constructors to enable compile-time canonicalization and prevent redundant widget rebuilds during UI animations.

customRules.name: Mandatory Disposal of Flutter Controllers & Subscriptions
customRules.description: All `AnimationController`, `TextEditingController`, `ScrollController`, `PageController`, `FocusNode`, and `StreamSubscription` instances must be cleanly disposed/cancelled in `dispose()` or state destruction methods to prevent memory leaks.

customRules.name: Secure Storage for Auth Tokens & Credentials
customRules.description: In Flutter/Mobile, authentication tokens, refresh tokens, passwords, and sensitive keys must NOT be stored in plain `SharedPreferences` or `UserDefaults`. Must use hardware-backed encrypted storage (`flutter_secure_storage`, Keystore, Keychain).

customRules.name: No Raw Exceptions In User Feedback (CWE-209 / OWASP)
customRules.description: Never expose raw error objects, technical exceptions, or stack traces directly to end users (e.g. `e.toString()`, `ex.Message`, `DioException`, `FirebaseException`, `SqlException`) in SnackBars, Toasts, Dialogs, Alerts, or Banners. All user feedback must present sanitized, user-friendly, actionable messages.

customRules.name: Proper Error Catching & Logging
customRules.description: Catch blocks must not be empty or silently swallow exceptions. Caught errors must be logged to a logger/telemetry system and converted to controlled failure/fallback states.

customRules.name: Safe Backend API Error Responses
customRules.description: Backend API endpoints / controllers must never return raw database exceptions, internal stack traces, or uncaught server errors (e.g. `StatusCode(500, ex.ToString())`) to HTTP clients. Responses must use standardized, sanitized error payloads (e.g. RFC 7807 Problem Details).

customRules.name: Propagate CancellationToken in Async Backend Operations
customRules.description: In .NET / C# backend controllers and services, asynchronous I/O methods (Entity Framework queries, HTTP client requests, file I/O) should accept and propagate `CancellationToken` from controller actions to abort wasted server compute when HTTP clients disconnect.

customRules.name: Avoid Sync-Over-Async Blocking (.Result / .Wait())
customRules.description: In .NET / C#, calling `.Result`, `.Wait()`, or `.GetAwaiter().GetResult()` on asynchronous Tasks is prohibited. Sync-over-async causes thread pool starvation, high latency, and deadlocks. Always use `await` asynchronously.

customRules.name: Mandatory Using Declarations on Disposable Resources
customRules.description: In .NET / C#, all types implementing `IDisposable` or `IAsyncDisposable` (e.g. DB connections, streams, HTTP responses) must be instantiated with `using var` or `await using` to prevent unmanaged resource leaks (S2930, S3971).

customRules.name: Exhaustive Dependencies in React Hooks
customRules.description: In React / Next.js, all reactive values (state, props) referenced inside `useEffect`, `useCallback`, or `useMemo` must be included in the dependency array to avoid stale closures or inconsistent state updates.

customRules.name: No Array Index as React Key in Dynamic Lists
customRules.description: Using array indices as keys (e.g. `key={index}`) in dynamic list rendering is prohibited when items can be reordered, filtered, added, or removed. Must use unique entity identifiers to prevent DOM reconciliation bugs and input state corruptions.

customRules.name: React useEffect Cleanup Required
customRules.description: Effects subscribing to events, intervals, WebSocket connections, or animations must return a cleanup function to prevent memory leaks and orphaned listeners.

customRules.name: Zero Hardcoded Color Hex Values
customRules.description: Hardcoded hex values (e.g. #067647, bg-[#...], style={{ color: '...' }}) are prohibited. Must use centralized design tokens or semantic theme classes.

customRules.name: Mandatory Image Alt Descriptions
customRules.description: All and components must provide a descriptive alt attribute (WCAG 2.1 AA).

customRules.name: Secure External Links
customRules.description: All external links with target='_blank' must include rel='noopener noreferrer' to prevent reverse tabnabbing.

customRules.name: Semantic Interactive Elements
customRules.description: Interactive elements must use semantic <button> or <Link> tags with keyboard accessibility and aria-label where icons lack text.

customRules.name: Broken Object Level Authorization Guard (OWASP API #1)
customRules.description: API endpoints accessing or mutating resources by ID must verify that the authenticated user owns or has permission to access that specific entity ID (IDOR / BOLA prevention). Prohibit direct entity retrieval by route ID without tenant/ownership checks.

customRules.name: Prevent N+1 Database Queries in ORMs
customRules.description: Prohibit executing individual database queries or lazy-loaded relation calls inside loops (EF Core, Prisma, TypeORM, Hibernate, SQL). Must use eager loading (`.Include()`, `join`, `in` batch querying) or aggregated projections to prevent database connection exhaustion.

customRules.name: Immutable State Updates (No Direct State Mutation)
customRules.description: Prohibit direct in-place mutation of state objects or collections (e.g. `state.items.push()` in React/Redux, or mutating properties on Bloc/Riverpod state instances in Flutter). State updates must always emit new immutable state instances via `copyWith()` or spread operators to guarantee predictable UI re-rendering.

customRules.name: Enforce Pagination on Database & API Queries
customRules.description: Prohibit querying database tables or returning API collections without strict pagination limits (e.g. missing `.Take(n)`, `limit: n`, or unbounded `SELECT *`). Queries returning unbounded result sets cause Out-Of-Memory (OOM) crashes and server Denial-of-Service under production scale.

customRules.name: Async Race Condition & Debounce Protection
customRules.description: Form submissions, purchase actions, and search input listeners must implement loading flags, debouncing, or cancellation tokens to prevent double-submit race conditions and out-of-order asynchronous responses.
